title: Measurement: a model is used only after an explicit, confirmed choice at a thinking level it supports, and its grant is bound to the exact model and cleared before a change
summary: TSK-0036, toward ACC-0055 and ACC-0054, as COMPONENT PROOF ONLY. The implementation is commit af8259e, which corrects 2dd4930's thinking-level check, and the sha256 of each file is in the facts. lib/model-selection.mjs chooses, confirms and persists the project's model, and records this host's model-use grant. CHOOSING. The choices are exactly the models a granted inspection listed, by provider display name and exact model ID, with nothing marked as a default. A choice is a number the operator typed, or --provider and --model checked against that list. Pi's global default is never read, and the first entry is never taken: an empty answer, q, 0, a number off the list, a non-integer, a name or a closed input cancels with nothing written. No thinking level is assumed; it comes from --thinking or an answer. THINKING LEVELS ARE THE MODEL'S. 2dd4930 checked --thinking only against Pi's global level list, and pinned Pi clamps a level the model does not support, so the confirmation could promise high while Pi ran at off. af8259e takes the supported levels from Pi's own getSupportedThinkingLevels, imported from the pi-ai the pinned agent resolves (resolvePinnedCompat), applied to the registry's model after inspection consent with allowModelNetwork false. Only supported levels are offered interactively, an unsupported --thinking is refused before any confirmation or write, a committed level the model does not support is not reused, and a model whose support Pi cannot report is refused. CONFIRMING. Every selection is confirmed, including a single listed model whose ID looks like an alias (kiln-latest). The prompt names the provider display name and ID, the exact model ID and the thinking level, and states that intake turns and specialist work will run on it using this computer's connection, may consume billable tokens or provider quota, and that the account, limits, pricing plan and charges are the operator's. Only true is a yes. A run that cannot ask refuses, even with valid flags. PERSISTING. On a yes to a changed selection, this host's model-use grant is cleared first, the exact provider, model and thinking level are merged into .pi/settings.json through applyKilnSettings (DEC-0028), and the grant is recorded for exactly that provider and model. If the grant cannot be cleared, the change is refused before anything is written or granted. A committed selection, as another operator or a Pi login (F14) may leave it, is offered for confirmation on a host with no grant and never used on the strength of the file. RESULTS. (1) Single model: no, a closed input and a non-boolean answer write neither file; yes writes the exact IDs and a grant of exactly granted, decidedAt, provider and model. (2) No default: nine answers other than a listed number cancel before any confirmation. (3) The list is exactly the three available models, with no default marker. (4) Committed selection on a new host: confirmation asked once, settings byte-identical after the yes, the grant recorded, and an unchanged rerun reused without asking. A no to that unchanged selection is recorded as this host's decline and reported without asking again. (5) DECLINED CHANGE: with A approved at high, a proposed --thinking low answered no leaves settings and the consent record byte-identical, and the approved selection is still reused without asking; a declined change of model through the flags does the same. (6) Flags: an invalid thinking level, a provider or model alone, an unknown provider and an unavailable model are refused before any prompt, with nothing written. (7) The merge keeps keys Kiln does not own. (8) ROUND TRIP: A to B clears A's grant before B is written and grants B on its own yes. B to A through Kiln asks, and a no leaves B and its grant. A hand edit back to A makes B's grant stale, and the next setup asks for A. (9) Clear before write: a concurrent edit that makes the settings merge refuse still leaves A's grant cleared and the selection unchanged. (10) REFUSED WITHOUT A CLEAR: with Git unavailable, and with the consent record tracked, a change from A to B is refused as grant-not-cleared with settings and the consent record byte-identical. (11) An uninspected host has nothing to choose from. (12) PI'S RULE, OBSERVED: a real inspection of an isolated agent directory with a non-reasoning and a reasoning custom model reports levels off for the first and off, minimal, low, medium, high for the second. (13) NON-REASONING CONTROL: --thinking high for the non-reasoning model is refused as thinking-level-not-supported, naming off as the supported level, with no confirmation shown, no settings file and no consent record. --thinking off is confirmed with Thinking: off and persisted. The reasoning model refuses xhigh and accepts high. (14) Interactively, the non-reasoning model's question offers only off and an answer of high cancels; the reasoning model's offers the five levels. (15) A committed high on the non-reasoning model, even with a model-use grant, is reported as unsupported and a level is asked from off only; confirming off persists it. (16) A listed model whose support Pi cannot report is refused before confirmation, by flag and interactively. LIMITS. Nothing here calls a model, so billable use enabled is observed as the grant and the settings, and that Pi runs at the confirmed level is inferred from its own rule rather than observed in a request. How a fresh non-interactive setup supplies model-use confirmation is TSK-0061's; provider and model flags alone do not grant it. Parsing the flags, placing the step in setup (TSK-0060) and the launch checks that read the grant (TSK-0037) are not connected, so ACC-0055 and ACC-0054 are not evaluated here. MUTATIONS, RUN LOCALLY ON WINDOWS. Eleven changes to af8259e each failed the tests: the flag level not checked against the model, every level offered interactively, an unsupported committed level reused, levels from the global list instead of Pi, unknown support accepted, no clear before the write, proceeding when the clear fails, a truthy answer as confirmation, a committed selection used with no grant, an empty answer taking the first entry, and recording a decline for a declined change. Against 2dd4930, the clear after the write and a single model skipping confirmation also each failed the tests. Each was restored byte-identical by sha256. CI. GitHub Actions run 35725046812 at 6a5582f passed in all four cells, but it covers 2dd4930, before the thinking-level fix. CI had not run on af8259e when this was updated, and its result is added separately.
